# find peaks function
https://github.com/stas-g/findPeaks 
```{r, echo= F}

# find peaks for each Anchorage ID
find_peaks <- function (x, m = 3){
    shape <- diff(sign(diff(x, na.pad = FALSE)))
    pks <- sapply(which(shape < 0), FUN = function(i){
       z <- i - m + 1
       z <- ifelse(z > 0, z, 1)
       w <- i + m + 1
       w <- ifelse(w < length(x), w, length(x))
       if(all(x[c(z : i, (i + 2) : w)] <= x[i + 1])) return(i + 1) else return(numeric(0))
    })
     pks <- unlist(pks)
     pks
}

# making a dataset of peaks
peaks <- profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% slice(find_peaks(-Depth_m)) %>% ungroup()
upeaks <-profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% slice(find_peaks(Depth_m)) %>% ungroup()
maxpeaks <- profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% slice(find_peaks(Depth_m)) %>% ungroup()

```


# sdmTMB model set up - making mesh, scaling predictors
```{r, echo = F}

peaks <-peaks %>% rename(Xm = X, Ym = Y)
get_crs(peaks, c("Longitude", "Latitude")) #function from sdmTMB to check coordinates crs


peaks <- add_utm_columns(peaks, c("Longitude", "Latitude"))

peaks <- peaks %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

peaks %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(diff_depth30), bins = 80) +
  xlim(-0.5, 0.25)

neg_peaks <-peaks %>% filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% mutate(deviations = abs(diff_depth30))

neg_peaks %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(deviations), bins = 80) +
  xlim(-0.5, 0.25)


#scale predictors
preds <- dplyr::select(neg_peaks, 
                       total_events,
                       total_events_premulti,
                       total_time,
                       total_time_premulti,
                       years_used,
                       last_used,
                       m_from_centre, 
                      )
peaks_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(preds, center = T, scale = T))
names(peaks_scaled) <- paste0(names(peaks_scaled), "_scaled")
peaks_scaled <- cbind(peaks_scaled,
                      neg_peaks)

peaks_scaled %>%  filter(is.na(total_time_premulti_scaled))

peaks_scaled <-peaks_scaled %>%  mutate(id = as.factor(main_anchorage.x)) %>% mutate(id = as.factor(anchorage)) 

mesh <- make_mesh(data = peaks_scaled, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 1) #the cutoff is in km

plot(mesh)


```

#model sets, models with .1 are with a spatial random effect on
```{r, echo =F}

peak_m1 <-sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m1.1 <-sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m2 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m2.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m3 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type*m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m3.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type*m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

AIC(peak_m1,peak_m1.1, peak_m2, peak_m2.1, peak_m3,peak_m3.1)


summary(peak_m3.1)


#checking simulation based randomized quantile residuals using DHARMa, KS test is significant but it looks fine and I think it is because there is a big sample size https://github.com/florianhartig/DHARMa/issues/181
set.seed(123)
s <- simulate(peak_m3.1, nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")
dharma_residuals(s, peak_m3.1)

peaks_scaled$resid <- residuals(peak_m3.1)
qqnorm(peaks_scaled$resid)

sanity(peak_m3.1)

qqline(peaks_scaled$resid)

#visualizing different parameters
visreg::visreg(peak_m3.1, "m_from_centre_scaled", scale = "response")
visreg::visreg(peak_m3.1, "total_time_premulti_scaled", scale = "response")
```


# response plot with distance and an interaction term with Type
```{r}

#The package ggeffects can be used to plot marginal effects of given predictor variables in sdmTMB models.

predict_final <- ggeffect(peak_m3.1, terms = c("m_from_centre_scaled", "Type")) %>%  
  rename(m_from_centre_scaled = x)

predict_final <-as_tibble(predict_final)
predict_final
#un center and unscale the predictions
predict_final <-predict_final %>% mutate(m_from_centre = m_from_centre_scaled*sd(peaks_scaled$m_from_centre)+
             mean(peaks_scaled$m_from_centre))

# creating a plot of the predictions with the raw data behind
p_depth <-ggplot(peaks_scaled, aes(x = m_from_centre, y = -deviations)) +

  # --- RAW DATA FIRST (so it's behind everything) ---
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Type),
    size = 1.6,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # --- MODEL LAYERS ON TOP ---

  # grey confidence ribbons
  geom_ribbon(
    data = predict_final,
    aes(
      x = m_from_centre,
      ymin = -conf.low,
      ymax = -conf.high,
      group = group
    ),
    fill = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.65,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # model prediction lines (coloured by Type)
  geom_line(
    data = predict_final,
    aes(
      x = m_from_centre,
      y = -predicted,
      colour = group,
      group = group
    ),
    linewidth = 1.3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # --- SCALES ---

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Anchorage" = "#1b9e77",
      "Control"   = "#d95f02"
    ),
    name = " Site type",
    breaks = c("Anchorage", "Control"),
                labels = c("Anchorage", "Reference"), # ensures both appear in legend
  ) +

  # --- AXES ---

  #controls how far data is from axes (have set x distance to zero in this case)
scale_x_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.05))
) +

coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, max(peaks_scaled$m_from_centre, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ylim = c(-0.5, 0)
) +

  labs(
    x = "Distance From Centre (m)",
    y = "Sediment disturbance depth (m)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines")
  )

p_depth

```
